stories.title: Multiple Windows Remote Desktop Vulnerabilities Allow Attackers to Execute Code Over Network
stories.description: Microsoft patched four Remote Desktop Client flaws, including three network-based RCE vulnerabilities.

stories.title: Dreeze Emerges From Stealth With $33M to Rebuild Cloud Apps After Cyberattacks
stories.description: Created by Zerto and Kashya veterans, the startup has launched a platform designed to recover whole cloud applications.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit AhsayCBS Vulnerabilities to Hide Malware in PNG Images and Deploy Stealthy Backdoors
stories.description: Hackers compromised AhsayCBS backup servers, deploying webshells, PNG-hidden malware, and Python implants to maintain access.

stories.title: ICS Patch Tuesday: Siemens Flags High-Severity Flaws, Node2Shell Exposure
stories.description: Pre-Patch Tuesday advisories were published by VDE CERT, Phoenix Contact, Johnson Controls, and Hitachi Energy.

stories.title: ClickFix Attacks Evolve to Hide Malware in PNG Images and Hijack Windows Domain Controllers
stories.description: ClickFix attacks hide malware in PNG images and fake verification prompts, enabling credential theft and corporate network breaches.

stories.title: China-Linked Hackers Use Fake Chrome Certificate Warnings to Infect Victims With Sparrow Backdoor
stories.description: China-linked hackers use fake Chrome certificate warnings on trusted websites to install backdoors and remotely access Windows systems.

stories.title: Threat Actors Exploit Openwave, Cisco BroadWorks Vulnerabilities
stories.description: The flaws, CVE-2026-111793 and CVE-2026-20320, let attackers leak sensitive information, including configuration data.

stories.title: Chipmaker Patch Tuesday: Over 200 Vulnerabilities Addressed by Intel, AMD
stories.description: Intel and AMD disclose more than 200 vulnerabilities, including critical flaws in Intel TDX software and numerous AMD graphics bugs.

stories.title: Microsoft Patches 1,259 Flaws, Including Exploited Outlook Bug That May Expose NTLMv2 Hashes
stories.description: Microsoft patches 1,259 flaws, including an actively exploited Outlook vulnerability that could expose NTLMv2 hashes through crafted files.

stories.title: Railway Says Stolen Customer AI Keys Led to $740,000 in Estimated Unauthorized Usage Charges
stories.description: Railway says stolen AI API keys caused $740,000 in unauthorized charges after attackers decrypted secrets in up to 100,000 workspaces.

stories.title: Microsoft Researchers Show AI Agents Can Be Backdoored by Editing Fewer Than 10 Neurons
stories.description: Microsoft demonstrates how editing as few as six AI model neurons can plant backdoors that trigger command execution by agents.

stories.title: Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Flaws Actively Exploited Despite Available Patches
stories.description: CISA adds exploited Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave flaws to its KEV catalog, requiring federal agencies to patch by November 24, 2026.
